license.notes: Zoo 1.93.0, roadmap 219 note 11. The walker, 2026-10-09: 'need filled black garbage bags stacked near the garbage bins'. A heap of filled bags: a row of two to five on the ground across the slot's width and one or two thrown on top, each slumped -- pressed flat where it sits, spread at the belly, lumpy, gathered at the top into a neck with a knot and two ears of its own plastic. Mostly black; the odd white kitchen bag or green contractor bag. One object and one material (glossy plastic, each bag's colour in Wear), so one draw a heap. Fitted to the slot's box, collision the slot's box. Lot stands one beside each building's dumpster. Planned purely in core/trash_bag_forms.py. REFERENCE: Garbage bags put out by a commercial building's dumpster on a 1990s Delaware County street: 30- to 40-gallon polyethylene bags, black or white, knotted at the neck, piled against the bin and each other.

notes: 1.93.0: each bag's colour is its own (core/trash_bag_forms.py COLOURS), carried in Wear; the style's `color` multiplies the whole heap, so it stays white. `variant` picks one of four heaps.
